build_GPTQConfig: build a GPTQConfig instance from a quantize_config.json dict with weight_bits, group_size, desc_act, and lm_head settings
create_GPTQLinearMethod: create a GPTQLinearMethod that wraps GPTQ quantization for linear layers using qweight, qzeros, scales, and g_idx parameters
test_GPTQConfig_from_config: test GPTQConfig.from_config parses quantize_config.json fields including bits, group_size, desc_act, lm_head, and dynamic per-module overrides
refactor_GPTQLinearMethod_apply: refactor GPTQLinearMethod.apply to run the gptq_gemm kernel on reshaped input with optional bias addition and output reshaping
review_GPTQLinearMethod_create_weights: review GPTQLinearMethod.create_weights for tensor-parallel alignment checks and parameter registration of qweight, g_idx, qzeros, and scales
summarize_GPTQConfig_get_quant_method: summarize GPTQConfig.get_quant_method which returns GPTQLinearMethod for linear layers and falls back to MoeWNA16 for FusedMoE layers
